title: Agent edit of a video card fails as a cloud provider error: a video ref is accepted into an image slot
description: Live 2026-09-29: asked the in-app agent to edit the first frame of a video with Nano Banana 2 Lite. The agent passed the video card itself as inputImage. resolveAgentMedia (js/data/generationControls.js) stamps the SLOT's mediaType on every ref and never checks what the ref is, so the mp4 went to routes/deepinfra.js as an image; sharp threw 'Input buffer contains unsupported image format' in _readReference and the user saw the generic 'The provider could not complete this generation' dialog (log: 'The reference image could not be read.'). Nothing was sent to DeepInfra, nothing billed. Fix: refuse a ref whose file type contradicts its slot, at the one resolver every agent path (in-app agent, MCP, HTTP connector) goes through, and tell the agent the user can make a picture card from a frame with the video viewer's right-click Create snapshot.
